                (∀ (a : Additive G), a ≠ 0 → Subsingleton (ShiftHom M.obj M.obj a)) → CategoryTheory.Indecomposable (D.finiteDimensionalModuleOrbitSkeletonPushdown.obj M)

                If an upstairs indecomposable module has no maps to any of its nontrivial shifts, then its literal finite skeletal push-down is indecomposable. This is the separated-window form of Gabriel's indecomposability argument and does not use density.
